# ankra_alert_ingest_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's alert ingest credentials: the endpoints external notifiers such as Prometheus Alertmanager deliver alerts into Ankra through. The token of a credential is shown only once, when it is created, and is never part of this listing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_alert_ingest_credentials" "all" {}

# Alertmanager webhook paths, by credential name. Append each to the Ankra API
# URL; the credential's token is only shown when it is created.
output "alertmanager_webhook_paths" {
  value = { for credential in data.ankra_alert_ingest_credentials.all.credentials : credential.name => credential.webhook_path }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Ingest credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the credential is pinned to; null when it is not pinned.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the credential accepts alerts.
- `id` (String) Credential id.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last delivery, RFC 3339; null when never used.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `scope` (String) `cluster`, `platform` or `mixed`: which alerts the credential accepts.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change, RFC 3339.
- `webhook_path` (String) Path on the Ankra API the notifier posts to, `/webhooks/alerts/<id>`.
